sample.question:
The synchronized front, right, and top panels show labeled beacons in a 4x4x4 coordinate cube. Coordinates are (x,y,z), each from 0 to 3. Rotation Z+ maps (x,y,z) to (3-y,x,z); rotation X+ maps it to (x,3-z,y).
Which pair occupies the same cell in the FRONT projection because only their y-coordinates differ?
A. C & D
B. A & B
C. A & C
D. A & D
E. B & C
F. B & D
sample.analysis: Front projection keeps (x,z) and collapses y. A is at (2, 3, 0); B is at (2, 0, 0). Their (x,z) values match, so the answer is B.
